title: BetterFoxes
description: Makes foxes better and more useful in game than ever before
body:
BetterFoxes improves foxes by making them tameable and breedable using chicken. Tamed foxes wear a collar, can bring raw or cooked chicken to nearby chests, and may boost your sneaking speed by 20% with a 15% chance.
Designed for Paper 1.21.x, balanced and survival-friendly.
